text: The increased use of online technologies has expanded the social landscape for individuals with ill-intent to sexually exploit and abuse children. To date, the specific psychological impact on and mental health outcomes for children who have experienced Technology-Assisted Child Sexual Abuse (TA-CSA) remain underexplored in comparison to those of CSA in the physical world.
source_label: The psychological impact on and mental health outcomes for victim-survivors of technology-assisted child sexual abuse: a systematic literature review
